content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to add a rung to a [product_name] ladder diagram? Something similar to the 'insert rung' feature found in other PLC programs? Thanks, [user_name]
I am only aware of this approach: You should insert all paths before, then select and use the arrow keys to move the chosen blocks. Please see the attachment.

[user_name], I'm not certain where in your code development you are at. [user_name] explained how to move existing rungs, so that should help. (Consider rating [user_name]'s video positively.) To create a rung, just place contacts and link to the power rail. You can also add additional pages if needed. I assume you're familiar with that process as well. If you require a larger workspace, you can modify the page size within print settings. Your comments or suggestions are appreciated. w

To add a rung, or more specifically to insert extra rows or columns, you can click the '1234' icon (page layout) in the diagram editor and select the amount of space you require. I also encountered some challenges initially, but eventually figured it out.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are seeking an easy way to insert a rung in a [product_name] ladder diagram, noting that the feature isn't as immediately accessible as in other PLC applications. Various alternatives are mentioned, such as moving existing blocks, using page layout controls, and adjusting editor workspace size. The exchange highlights that the process can be unintuitive and somewhat challenging, potentially making workflow less efficient.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would prefer a straightforward and direct method for adding a rung in the ladder diagram, similar to the 'insert rung' button available in other PLC environments. They expect to be able to expand their diagrams smoothly, without the need for additional workaround steps.
